questions.question: Which of the following titles was traditionally attributed to the Egyptian Pharaoh, who was also seen as a divine ruler?
questions.explanation: The title 'Son of Re' emphasized the divine lineage of the Pharaoh, as he was considered a descendant of the sun god Re. This was a central aspect of royal ideology in ancient Egypt, legitimizing the power and status of the Pharaoh.

choices: Which piece of furniture became popular in many European households in the 18th century, symbolizing the growing prosperity of bourgeois society?

questions.question: The secretary desk became an important piece of furniture in bourgeois households in the 18th century. It represented education and wealth, often equipped with writing materials and books, embodying the bourgeois ideal of an educated person.

choices: Which of the following English words has Slavic origins?
The word 'vodka' comes from the Slavic word 'voda', meaning 'water'. This reflects the cultural significance of distilled spirits in Slavic countries. Other options have different etymological roots.

questions.question: A: Vodka
choices: What concept describes the measure of getting AI systems to make ethical decisions and consider societal values?
